title: Top pop-ups open near the top and side drawers open on the right in the member app

source.ref: Follow-up to LIVE-2438 (2026-11-19); owner authorized finishing all work overnight, coordinator asked for this pass.

detail:
Same root cause as LIVE-2438: the shared Dialog's portaled overlay carries `data-kit="members"`, and the kit's unlayered flex column beats the row its utilities assume. `align="top"` (the default, so most dialogs) sat mid-screen and a tall one clipped its own top under `justify-center`; `align="drawer"` opened full width instead of a right-hand panel; `align="overlay"` sat at its natural height instead of filling the frame.

DONE 2026-11-19: panel classes that hold in both flex directions. top: `mx-auto mb-auto mt-[6vh]`; drawer: `h-full min-h-0 self-end`; overlay: `min-h-0 flex-1`. Overlay classes unchanged. Rendered bottom, sheet, center, top, drawer and overlay at 390, 1280 and 1440 in the member kit: top sits 6vh from the top and centred, drawer is a right-hand panel at its max width, overlay fills, the rest unchanged.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
